title: Under the Radar: Carson Clark
parts:
🔍 UNDER THE RADAR

Carson Clark | WR | San José State | FR | 3⭐

#51 WR in the Alpha Draft Signal, up from #466 preseason.

Stories written about him this week: zero.

A true freshman catching 6 balls a game deserves a closer look. 🧵

📊 2026 SO FAR (11 games)

• 67 rec, 746 yds, 5 TD
• 67.8 rec yds/g · long of 63
• 11.1 yds/rec
• 31% of San José State's receiving yards
• 2.20 yds per team pass attempt

Among 60 true-freshman WRs on the board with 4+ games: 3rd in rec/g, 4th in team yard share.

🧪 UNDER THE HOOD (PFF, first 10 games)

• 2.24 yds per route run, 94th of 503 FBS WRs with 100+ routes
• 61 catches, 10th of those 503
• 29 first downs
• 11.1-yd avg depth of target
• 7 of 13 contested targets caught

Just 3.2 YAC per catch. He wins at the catch point.

📏 5'9", 170 · lines up in the slot 95% of the time

His production comps: Willie Wright, KJ Hamler, Dante Wright.

Who else is a true freshman putting up this kind of volume with nobody talking about it? 👇
